definitions: Throw (something) forcefully in a specified direction.
Direct (one's eyes or a look) in a particular direction.
Cause (light or shadow) to appear on a surface.
Select (actors) for all the parts in a play, film, or show.
Shape (molten metal or other material) by pouring it into a mould as it cools and hardens.
examples: He cast the net into the sea.
She cast a glance at her watch.
The lamp cast a warm glow.
Every citizen has the right to cast their vote.
The director cast her in the lead role.
The bell was cast in bronze.
